Make an enquiry Make an enquiry Alumni Search Search search Business Services Talent and recruitment Talent and Recruitment Make an enquiry We'll help you find and develop your future leaders or build short-term capacity in your team. Our students and graduates have high-level skills, fresh thinking, and huge potential. By offering them work opportunities, you can help nurture their talent and bring new skills into your business. As an applied University, our students and graduates are already experienced at using their knowledge to solve real business challenges, and we help them build practical and technical skills during their course. This means they can jump straight into your organisation and hit the ground running. If you are looking to offer work opportunities to help nurture their talent and bring new skills into your organisation, the Derby Talent Team can work with you to help you find your future leaders, graduate talent and build short term capacity in your team. As part of the Careers and Employment Service, the Derby Talent Team are specialists in student and graduate recruitment, offering help, advice and guidance to organisations. Hire our graduates Access our industry engaged graduates by promoting your graduate level opportunities. Work with our students There are many ways to engage with our students, from year in industry placements, to delivering in curriculum, plus much more. Career fairs and events Attend our events to raise your profile on campus and to share your opportunities and expertise with our students and graduates. Funding for internships Through the Derby Talent Programme your business may be eligible for financial support towards the costs of employing a student or graduate intern. Employer toolkit Utilise our free toolkit to maximise reaching students, recruiting graduates and retaining your employees. Working with employers The Derby Talent Team work closely with employers to create meaningful opportunities that enhance students learning and career prospects. These collaborations strengthen industry engagement and ensure students gain real-world insights. Find out more Find out more Wider business services The University of Derby is a university of and for business; an applied university, committed to using our research and knowledge, expertise and resources to inspire and develop the organisations of today and tomorrow. Using technology, we offer learning and personal development, industry-shaping research and innovation, digital networking events and seminars along with support to nurture and recruit your workforce. For further information, learn about our growing innovation and business . The University of Derby is our first port-of-call for new talent. We have employed 15 graduates, hosted six students for their ‘year in industry’, and provided placements for a masters student and PhD students. Keith Cox Director and Founder, Bloc Digital Get in touch To discuss any of this information in more detail, please get in touch with the Derby Talent Team . Their job is to make it easy for you to access our student and graduate talent and they have lots of experience working with organisations across many sectors. Make an enquiry Make an enquiry Alumni Search Search search Organisation About us Data governance Book your Open Day Book your Open Day Data Governance When you request information from the University of Derby we are governed by various pieces of legislation. Here is an overview of the main pieces of law we work to. Data Protection The Data Protection Act 2018 and the UK GDPR (effective from 1 January 2021) are designed to help protect your personal data by setting out rules and conditions which we must follow when collecting and using this data. They aim to ensure that you know where your data is held, what it is used for, and who it is shared with. These regulations give you certain rights, including access to your personal data, and ensure that legislation keeps pace with the ever-changing technology around us. For more information, visit the ICO website . Data Protection Data Protection Policy Privacy Notices Whether you are a student, member of staff or an organisation, your privacy is important to us. Our privacy notice(s) aim to advise you on the way we look after your data at various stages, including your rights to access this data. Privacy Notices Cyber Security With cyber attacks evolving, to threaten organisations and individuals, cyber security is more important than ever. Cyber security Freedom of information The Freedom of Information (FOI) Act 2000 gives a general right of access to all types of 'recorded' information held by public authorities (no matter how the information is held). We maintain a publication scheme, which sets out the categories of information we are required to publish. FOI requests must be made in writing. They can be emailed to foi@derby.ac.uk Alternatively, requests can be posted to: Assurance Services Legal Governance and Assurance Services University of Derby Kedleston Road Derby DE22 1GB Freedom of Information Requests FOI and EIR Policy Environmental Information Regulations The Environmental Information Regulations 2004 give a general right of access to all types of 'recorded' environmental information held by public authorities. Environmental information covered by the regulations includes the state of the air, atmosphere, water, soil, land, and landscape, as well as factors affecting the above elements such as substances, energy, noise, radiation or waste, emissions, discharges into the environment. Environmental information regulations FOI and EIR Policy Records Management Records Management is governed by a number of laws and regulations, several of which concern Data Protection and Freedom of Information. Records management is the practice of maintaining records safely from the time they are created for University business activities, during retention and up to their eventual disposal. This includes classifying, storing, securing, the destruction and in some cases archival preservation of records. A record can be on paper, digital or a physical object. Find out more about our data protection policies Contact us If you have a question about how we use your personal information, please email us at gdpr@derby.ac.uk University of Derby logo UDO Staff Library Find us Contact us News Events Blog Jobs Press Our staff Our organisation Alumni Business Services Facebook X (formerly Twitter) Instagram YouTube LinkedIn TikTok Data governance Accessibility Privacy policy Modern Slavery Safeguarding Prevent Covid-19 London Derby

Make an enquiry Make an enquiry Alumni Search Search search Organisation About us Data governance Book your Open Day Book your Open Day Data Governance When you request information from the University of Derby we are governed by various pieces of legislation. Here is an overview of the main pieces of law we work to. Data Protection The Data Protection Act 2018 and the UK GDPR (effective from 1 January 2021) are designed to help protect your personal data by setting out rules and conditions which we must follow when collecting and using this data. They aim to ensure that you know where your data is held, what it is used for, and who it is shared with. These regulations give you certain rights, including access to your personal data, and ensure that legislation keeps pace with the ever-changing technology around us. For more information, visit the ICO website . Data Protection Data Protection Policy Privacy Notices Whether you are a student, member of staff or an organisation, your privacy is important to us. Our privacy notice(s) aim to advise you on the way we look after your data at various stages, including your rights to access this data. Privacy Notices Cyber Security With cyber attacks evolving, to threaten organisations and individuals, cyber security is more important than ever. Cyber security Freedom of information The Freedom of Information (FOI) Act 2000 gives a general right of access to all types of 'recorded' information held by public authorities (no matter how the information is held). We maintain a publication scheme, which sets out the categories of information we are required to publish. FOI requests must be made in writing. They can be emailed to foi@derby.ac.uk Alternatively, requests can be posted to: Assurance Services Legal Governance and Assurance Services University of Derby Kedleston Road Derby DE22 1GB Freedom of Information Requests FOI and EIR Policy Environmental Information Regulations The Environmental Information Regulations 2004 give a general right of access to all types of 'recorded' environmental information held by public authorities. Environmental information covered by the regulations includes the state of the air, atmosphere, water, soil, land, and landscape, as well as factors affecting the above elements such as substances, energy, noise, radiation or waste, emissions, discharges into the environment. Environmental information regulations FOI and EIR Policy Records Management Records Management is governed by a number of laws and regulations, several of which concern Data Protection and Freedom of Information. Records management is the practice of maintaining records safely from the time they are created for University business activities, during retention and up to their eventual disposal. This includes classifying, storing, securing, the destruction and in some cases archival preservation of records. A record can be on paper, digital or a physical object.
